content.what_it_is: Python script that loads a Tohoku depth grid and selected eta outputs from hard-coded workstation paths (L9-L13), derives geographic coordinate arrays (L16-L21), masks eta where dep is negative, draws one subplot per selected output with distinct color limits, and saves eta_tsunami.png (L33-L58).

unresolved: Portability defect at L9-L13: both dep and eta locations are developer-specific absolute paths despite the instruction to supply one's own path; running elsewhere requires source edits.
Cross-array shape assumption at L11-L21 and L35-L40: eta is masked with dep and plotted on dep-derived coordinates without checking matching dimensions.
The independent nfile and hr lists at L23-L24 are indexed by the same num at L34 and L42 but equal lengths are not enforced; changing only nfile can cause an out-of-range hr access.

Ordering defect at L33-L56: the global font-size update occurs after each panel's title/labels/colorbar are created. On a fresh process the first panel uses the prior default while later panels can use size 10, yielding inconsistent typography.
Matplotlib pcolor at L40 does not specify shading while x/y lengths match eta dimensions; behavior can vary by Matplotlib version between boundary truncation and acceptance with automatic shading.
